4: NIKÍTA [ listening ] Don't bury it, it's alive! Don't you hear? Alive! There—it's whimpering! There … quite plain! MATRYÓNA. How can it whimper? Why, you've flattened it into a pancake! The whole head is smashed to bits!
3: NIKÍTA [ rushes out of the hut towards the cellar ] Mother! mother, I say! MATRYÓNA [ puts out her head ] What is it, sonnie?
1: ANÍSYA [ looking towards the door by which Nikíta entered the hut ] Well, have you had enough spree? You've been puffing yourself up, but now you'll know how it feels! You'll lose some of your bluster!
